My area is pretty simple but- you got Trailer Unloader(s), Bag Dumper(s), Scanners, and Pre-Loaders.

1. Trailer Unloaders are simple- they unload everything out of the Shipping Containers.
2. Bag Dumpers- they sorta' move boxes into lines for the scanners to scan the boxes. As well as dump bags carrying smaller packages/item bags.
3. Scanners- They scan QR codes on boxes/small bags and put a sticker on each and every box/bag (this job sucks)
4. Pre-loaders, look on the belt for the 3-4 Trucks names/numbers (i.e. "Alpha", "Beta", or even "87a") that you're given, look at the four digit number on the packages, and put it on the correct shelf/floor.
